proposed_memory.lesson: When restricted to a small set of valid strategies and forced to choose exactly one, avoid oscillating between options. Instead, thoroughly re-examine task conditions to identify the single best choice and commit to it without fluctuation.
proposed_memory.next_strategy: Select one strategy decisively from the valid candidates and submit it immediately without further alternation.
proposed_memory.observed_problem: Repeated incorrect selections from the limited valid candidates without identifying the single intended correct answer.
